title: Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Recruitment

Indian Navy B.Tech January Recruitment 2027 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed Class 10+2 Exam with 70% Marks in PCM Subjects and 50% Marks in English in Class 10 or 12 Level will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • Note – Candidates who have appeared for JEE (Main) -2026 (for B.E./ B.Tech) exam. Call up for Service Selection Board (SSB) will be issued on the basis of JEE (Main) – 2026 All India Rank published by NTA.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.
